title: The Haunted Mirror
description: A dimly lit institutional hallway features a large painting of an identical hallway with an open yellow door, while a woman in a dark uniform stands behind a rain-streaked glass panel on the left, her hand pressed against the surface. An open book and pen rest on a wooden table in the foreground.
prompt: A surreal cinematic scene inside a decaying institutional hallway with damp concrete walls and patterned wallpaper. On the right hangs a large painting depicting the same hallway with an open glowing yellow door at the end. On the left, behind a rain-streaked glass partition, stands a young woman in a dark uniform with a name tag, staring intently with her hand pressed to the glass. An open notebook and pen lie on a wooden table in the foreground. Moody lighting, cinematic atmosphere, high detail.
